title: Calcarea Arsenica
text:
Calcarea Arsenica.

         Arsenite of Lime



Great mental depression.   The slightest emotion
        causes palpitation of heart   (Lith. c.). Rush of blood to head and left chest
        (Amyl., Glon.). Epilensies, from valvular diseases of the heart. Complaints of drunkards,
        after abstaining; craving for alcohol (Asar., Sul. ac.). Complaints of fleshy women when
        approaching the menopause.


  Relations  . - Compare: Con., Glon.,
        Lith. c., Puls., Nux. Follows well: after Conium, in lymphatic, psoric or tubercular
        persons.



 Keynotes  by H.C. Allen
